article.title: Ubiquitous
article.description: Meaning: present, appearing, or found everywhere. Pronunciation: yoo-BIK-wi-tuhs. Example: 'Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.' Register: formal/academic, common in IELTS Writing Task 2 essays about technology or globalization.
article.content: Meaning: present, appearing, or found everywhere. Pronunciation: yoo-BIK-wi-tuhs. Example: 'Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.' Register: formal/academic, common in IELTS Writing Task 2 essays about technology or globalization.

generated.caption:
Ever want a more impressive word for 'everywhere'? 🤔 Meet 'ubiquitous' (yoo-BIK-wi-tuhs)!

It means present, appearing, or found everywhere. This formal word is perfect for IELTS essays or business English to sound super precise!

For example: 'Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.'

slides.body: The word 'Ubiquitous' (pronounced 'yoo-BIK-wi-tuhs') means present, appearing, or found everywhere. It describes something that is extremely common and widespread. For example, 'Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life' perfectly illustrates how common these devices are. This is a formal, academic word, often used in IELTS Writing Task 2 essays when discussing topics like technology or globalization.
